description: The Andhra Pradesh government has approved AM AI Factory Pvt Ltd's plan for a 512-MW green integrated AI data centre in Visakhapatnam, involving a ₹31,387 crore investment. This project is set to significantly boost India's AI compute infrastructure and digital capacity with substantial state support.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh government has granted approval to AM AI Factory Pvt Ltd for the establishment of a 512-megawatt (MW) green integrated artificial intelligence (AI) data centre facility in Visakhapatnam district. The project, entailing an investment exceeding ₹31,387 crore, is slated for development at Amanam village in Bheemunipatnam mandal. State Incentives and Support The Andhra Pradesh government will provide both non-fiscal and fiscal incentives to support the project. Non-fiscal support includes essential power infrastructure and water supply.
